payout_quote: Official Bank of America offer: open a new Advantage Plus Banking or Advantage Relationship Banking account through the offer page by September 30, 2026 and earn a tiered bonus — $100 at $2,000 total qualifying direct deposits, $300 at $5,000, $500 at $10,000+ — with deposits made within 90 days of account opening.
timing: Bonus deposited within 60 days after the 90-day deposit period ends and all requirements are met.
steps: Go to https://promotions.bankofamerica.com/en/offers/chooseyourchecking500100 and open a new Advantage Plus Banking or Advantage Relationship Banking account (SafeBalance excluded) by September 30, 2026.
Set up qualifying direct deposits and reach your tier within 90 days of opening: $2,000 total = $100, $5,000 = $300, $10,000+ = $500.
Keep the account open and in good standing; the bonus is deposited within 60 days after the 90-day deposit period ends.
Avoid the $12 monthly fee with $250+ in qualifying direct deposits, a $1,500 minimum daily balance, or Preferred Rewards.
catches: TIERED: $100 at $2,000 total DD / $300 at $5,000 / $500 at $10,000+ — most users will land the $100 tier, not $500.
Must open through the promo offer page (https://promotions.bankofamerica.com/en/offers/chooseyourchecking500100) — opening any other way gets $0.
Expires September 30, 2026 (offer must be opened by that date).
New checking customers only — must not have owned or co-owned a BoA personal checking account in the last 12 months.
SafeBalance accounts are excluded from this tiered offer (separate $100 SafeBalance offer exists: 20 qualifying debit/Zelle transactions within 60 days).
Advantage Plus carries a $12/month maintenance fee (waivable with $250+ qualifying DD, $1,500 minimum daily balance, or Preferred Rewards).
biggest_catch: The headline 'up to $500' needs a $10,000 direct-deposit stack — the ordinary $2,000-deposit tier pays only $100, and the whole offer expires September 30, 2026.
eligibility: New BoA personal checking customers 18+; no BoA personal checking owned/co-owned in the last 12 months; Advantage Plus or Advantage Relationship Banking only.
notes: Verified 2026-09-23 via the official promotions.bankofamerica.com offer page and the official BoA resource PDF. Catalog's $200 claim is superseded by the official tier table — an ordinary user routing $2,000 in DDs earns $100, not $200; the headline must not promise more. Do not confuse with the separate $750 business-checking promo (through 12/31/2026). App links left null.
